Make it their story

Whose photo should I use?
Choose a clear photo of the person you want drawn. A child can star in their own book, or a grandparent can be the hero of a story written for a three-year-old.
What makes it personal?
Try one detail they’d recognise straight away. Their favourite muddy wellies, a toy crocodile or the squeaky gate at Nana’s can give you the start of a story.
Can I see the book first?
The free preview shows the character, cover and opening illustrated pages. You can read and edit the words before ordering.
How much is a printed book?
With £3.99 UK postage, the A5 hardback is £28.98 delivered (£24.99 for the book). The larger A4 hardback is £33.98 delivered (£29.99 for the book).
When will it arrive?
Your full illustrated proof is ready within seven calendar days of payment. After you approve it, printing and UK delivery usually take another 7 to 12 working days. Allow extra time for changes. See ordering and delivery.

Who’s turning the first page?

Start with a name and a photo. Add a dedication if you’d like them to remember who first read it with them.
